image_description: A close-up, side-profile view of a weasel (likely a stoat or short-tailed weasel in summer coat) emerging from behind a textured tree trunk on the left. The animal has a slender, elongated body covered in rich brown fur on its back and white/cream fur on its underside. Its head is triangular with a pointed snout, small dark eye, and rounded ear. The background is a soft-focus mix of grey rocks and green vegetation.
